lede: TYREPLUS Toh Guan is a car workshop in Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub. Its own website lists tyre replacement, puncture repair, wheel alignment and engine oil servicing.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention fast tyre changes, help choosing tyres, tyre rotation and balancing, puncture checks at no charge when no repair was needed, and servicing without hard selling.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, citytyre.com.sg.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
good_to_know: Enquiries by WhatsApp, according to its website
